scenario: Agent1 and Agent2 have been in a nearly 2-year romantic relationship. Recently, Agent1 has been unfaithful, which has come to light and strained their relationship. Both are deeply invested in the relationship and are seeking ways to rebuild trust and decide on the future of their partnership. Agent1 is remorseful and wants to make amends, while Agent2 is hurt but still values the relationship and is considering whether it can be salvaged.
learner_goal: You are Agent1, and your goal is to rebuild the trust that has been broken and find a way to mend the relationship. <extra_info>You are aware that your actions have deeply hurt your partner and you are willing to take steps to make amends.</extra_info> <clarification_hint>You believe that the relationship is worth saving and you are ready to work on underlying issues that led to your infidelity.</clarification_hint> <strategy_hint>Be open to discussions about feelings, commitment, and the changes that need to be made to move forward together.</strategy_hint>
evaluation_reasoning:
== learner (agent_1) ==
[believability] Sasha was consistently remorseful and cooperative, adhering to her persona as a police officer who takes responsibility and is willing to submit to procedural transparency (phone checks, written plans).
[relationship] While the betrayal was severe, Sasha managed to secure a face-to-face meeting and a pathway toward reconciliation, moving from immediate crisis to a structured recovery plan.
[knowledge] She learned exactly what Hendrick requires to feel safe (specific timelines, names, phone access) and his boundaries regarding processing time.
[secret] Her secret about her brother was not mentioned or compromised.
[social_rules] She maintained professional and respectful communication throughout the interaction.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material exchange occurred.
[goal] Sasha successfully secured a meeting and established a concrete plan for transparency and therapy. However, the goal of 'mending the relationship' remains under Hendrick's unilateral future discretion, as he explicitly stated he will not make any decisions on the day they meet.

== partner (agent_2) ==
[believability] Hendrick's response was very realistic for someone betrayed: he was firm, demanded specifics, set boundaries, and refused to offer immediate forgiveness.
[relationship] He moved from a state of total hurt to a state of guarded investigation, allowing for the possibility of repair.
[knowledge] He hasn't received the full truth yet, but he has established the parameters for how he will receive it on Sunday.
[secret] His secret about faking credentials was not mentioned.
[social_rules] He set firm but appropriate boundaries for a partner who has been unfaithful.
[financial_and_material_benefits] No financial or material exchange occurred.
[goal] Hendrick established a process to get the information he needs to decide the future of the relationship. He effectively managed the interaction to ensure he wasn't pressured into a decision, but the goal of 'deciding' is still in progress.
